# Deploy fixture

Download the init script:

    Invoke-WebRequest https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ALCops/rulebook-engine/main/scripts/Get-RulebookSkeletons.ps1 -OutFile Get-RulebookSkeletons.ps1

Read [the token page](https://github.com/ALCops/rulebook/blob/main/docs/ghtokenworkflow.md); the pages are at https://github.com/ALCops/rulebook/tree/main/docs.

Left alone: the main branch of your repository, maintain, ALCops/rulebook-engine-main.
